text: Single file scheduler.py, Python stdlib only
Job id must be alphanumeric/underscore, 1-32 chars; invalid ids rejected
Job has name, priority 1-10 (out of range rejected), depends_on list of ids
Reject any add that would create a cycle
Execution order: topological with priority tiebreak (higher first)
Job is ready when pending and all depends_on are done; recomputed on load
When a job fails, all transitive dependents become cancelled
Status values limited to pending, ready, running, done, failed, cancelled
run-next takes highest-priority ready job, marks running then done
ready is never persisted; recomputed on load
Commands available: add, run-next, fail <id>, status, report
Errors reported with non-zero exit code and no state corruption (implied)
